entry.name: plugreceive~
entry.description: The use of the plugsend~ and plugreceive~ objects to pass audio between Max for Live devices is not supported. The plugreceive~ and plugsend~ objects were used to send audio signals from one pluggo plug-in to another. They were used in the implementation of the PluggoBus feature of many of the plug-ins included with pluggo.
